title: Vertex AI Vector Search (Private Network)
description: Template schema for deploying Google Cloud Vertex AI Vector Search within a private VPC network or Private Service Connect (PSC) for enterprise RAG applications.

display_name.description: Display name for the Vertex AI Vector Search Index.

description.default: Vertex AI Vector Search — Private Network Deployment
description.description: Description for the Vector Search resources.

network.description: VPC network resource ID for private peering (e.g., projects/{project_id}/global/networks/{network_name}).

enable_private_service_connect.description: Enable Private Service Connect (PSC) for endpoint connectivity.

psc_project_allowlist.description: List of GCP project IDs allowed to connect via PSC.

allowed_invoker_members.description: IAM identities granted roles/aiplatform.user on the index endpoint.

dimensions.description: Dimensionality of vector embeddings (e.g. 768 for text-embedding-004).

distance_measure_type.description: Distance metric for nearest neighbor calculations.

algorithm.description: Indexing algorithm (tree_ah uses ScaNN; brute_force performs exact search).

index_update_method.description: STREAM_UPDATE enables real-time insertion/deletion; BATCH_UPDATE uses GCS batch files.

create_staging_bucket.description: Create a private GCS bucket for staging document embeddings and data.

machine_type.description: Compute machine type for serving node replicas.
